# Moon 0.4.13 beta
Move freely. Speak naturally. Browse privately.
- Swipe left to move forward or instantly create a space, and right to return. Automatic names, quiet page dots, and optional renaming keep setup out of the way. - Move between spaces without losing the original tabs or active page. New spaces share existing website sign-ins automatically. - Hold Option–Space for Nebula. English and Spanish commands and context-aware dictation no longer require a mode or language picker. - Nebula stays off the sidebar mini dock. Microphone capture still stops on release, cancellation, or leaving Moon. - Quick force-click a web link for a short description; hold a force-click for a full page preview, with native haptic feedback on supported trackpads. - Open a Ghost window with Shift–Command–N, or a Ghost tab from File. Ghost uses temporary website storage and stays out of history, saved sessions and reopen lists. - Control–Option–Command–H closes Ghost browsing. Private tabs deny precise location permission by default; websites can still see your IP address.
Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later. English and Spanish speech uses Apple’s on-device models. This Moon beta is Apple Development signed and is not Apple-notarized.
